The VenueReplace with a venue photograph
Where we'll say 'I do'

A beautiful place for a beautiful day.

Makiti Wedding Venue

Sterkfontein Cave Rd, nestled in the secluded Kromdraai valley, Krugesdorp built on a 50 hectare estate, lies our beautiful and exclusive venue in south africa's well known world heritage sites. The river meanders under big old trees and majestic cliffs that form the backdrop of our beautifully landscaped gardens.

From the ceremony to the last dance, everything will take place at this special location.

Dress code

Formal evening elegance. We invite you to dress to impress and celebrate in style.

II

A little note

On our wedding day, as the magic unfolds, There’ll be precious moments only your camera holds. A stolen smile, a laugh, a sweet surprise, We’d love to relive it all through your eyes. On the day, look out for our QR code to upload your favourite photographs, so we can experience the magic of our wedding through your eyes, too.

Our guest photo space will open after the celebration.
